EN: Makes Swiss cheese out of any armor - and body - in the Wasteland.
ZH: 能够从废土任何装甲——和尸体上——做出瑞士奶酪。

EN: Today's forecast calls for a rain of bullets.
ZH: 今天的天气预报说要下子弹雨了。

EN: Shooting that many rounds may not be necessary, but it sure is fun.
ZH: 射击许多轮可能不是必要的，但它肯定是有趣的。

EN: It just. Doesn't. Stop. Shooting. And. Killing.
ZH: 它只是……不停止地……射击。然后……杀死。

EN: The barrel doesn't spin up quite as fast, but when it does... ouch.
ZH: 弹筒旋转得不快，但当它快的时候……哎呦喂。

EN: Shoots a powerful explosive projectile. Kaboom!
ZH: 发射一个强大的爆炸弹。爆炸！

EN: A few tweaks have made this baby even more deadly than normal.
ZH: 一些调整使这个宝贝比平时更致命。

EN: Shoots a powerful guided missile, right down the enemy's throat.
ZH: 发射一个强大的导弹，正中敌人的咽喉。

EN: More explosive power, with faster firing. This thing delivers.
ZH: 用更快的速度，产生更大的爆发力。这家伙能帮你。

EN: She's packed with boom and va-va-voom.
ZH: 她会让现场充满了爆炸和哇哇叫。

EN: A little beat up, but it still works. And that's all that matters.
ZH: 有一点松动，但仍然有效。这就够了。

EN: This scattergun is sure to get you home.
ZH: 这款散弹枪一定能带你回家。

EN: This far underground, you just may strike gold.
ZH: 在地下挖这么深，说不定真能挖到金子。

EN: Crude but functional favorite of the Wasteland Raider.
ZH: 废土掠夺者的最爱。粗糙但实用。

EN: Spray and pray! You might even hit something.
ZH: 乱射然后祈祷吧！说不定还能打中点什么。

EN: Might not hit hard, but it sure hits fast.
ZH: 可能不会伤害很大，但一定出手快。

EN: The bigger the pipe, the harder the fall.
ZH: 管子越大，摔得越惨。

EN: Like the name implies, it's more annoying than dangerous.
ZH: 就像这个名字所暗示的，比起危险，它更令人讨厌。

EN: Can a pistol this crude really be called accurate? It can now!
ZH: 这么粗劣的手枪真的能瞄准目标吗？它可以！

EN: If your target survives, you'll get a running head start.
ZH: 即使目标得以幸存下来，你仍能得到有利的逃跑条件。

EN: Because sometimes you want to get up close and personal.
ZH: 因为有时候你想要近战。

EN: Boss your enemies around. At least until mom and dad get home.
ZH: 对你的敌人颐指气使。至少直到爸妈回家之前。

EN: A lot more lethal than it looks.
ZH: 比它看起来的样子更致命。

EN: It's always more fun when they don't see it coming.
ZH: 当他们看不到它发生的时候，总是很有趣。

EN: When in doubt, always shoot from the shadows.
ZH: 当不确定的时候，总是从黑暗中射击。

EN: The most common handgun found in the Wasteland.
ZH: 废土上最常见的手枪。

EN: Bring justice to the Wasteland, one Raider corpse at a time.
ZH: 为废土世界主持正义，一次搞定一个掠夺者尸体。

EN: Higher damage capacity, freshly oiled. Oh yeah.
ZH: 新上了油，伤害更高。哦，真赞。

EN: Lovingly engineered and modified. A mercenary's dream.
ZH: 精心设计和修改过。一个雇佣兵的梦想。

EN: One hero. One handgun. And thus, a legend was born.
ZH: 一个英雄。一把手枪。于是，一个传奇诞生了。

EN: Not the most reliable pistol in the world, but it'll do in a pinch.
ZH: 不是世界上最可靠的手枪，但它会在紧要关头帮你。

EN: The best way to get the most plasma possible on target.
ZH: 以最有效的方式将尽可能多的等离子体射向目标。

EN: Green hell from a heavenly new ergonomic frame.
ZH: 天堂般的人体工学设计，地狱般的绿色火力。

EN: Your enemies won't just be puddles, they'll be impressed puddles.
ZH: 你的敌人不仅仅会变成一滩烂泥，还会给这把枪的火力点个赞呢！

EN: Its terrible power is only matched by its troubling leakage.
ZH: 它可怕的威力，只有那令人担忧的泄漏能与之匹敌。

EN: The most devastating handgun ever developed.
ZH: 最具破坏性的手枪。

EN: Reach out, pull the trigger, and turn your enemy into goo.
ZH: 伸手，扣动扳机，把你的敌人变成一团粘液。

EN: Yup, you just turned that Slaver into a green puddle. Well done!
ZH: 是的，你只是把敌人变成一个绿色的水坑。干得漂亮！

EN: The power of a green sun in the palm of your hand.
ZH: 一个绿色太阳的力量在你手里。

EN: Its plasma may not be as hot, but it's damned sure hot enough.
ZH: 它的等离子可能不会那么热，但它肯定足够“惹火”。

EN: Just a little hotter, and a little greener, than the standard model.
ZH: 只是比标准等离子手枪热那么一点，绿那么一点。

EN: “Gooify” your enemies at range with superheated plasma.
ZH: 用超高温等离子远距离把敌人化成一滩浆。

EN: What this thing does to the human body is beyond comprehension.
ZH: 这把枪打在人身上会造成什么后果，完全无法想象。

EN: Can transform a charging Super Mutant into a puddle of sludge.
ZH: 可以将进攻的超级变种人变成一滩泥。

EN: Possibly the cruelest high-tech weapon ever made by humankind.
ZH: 可能是有史以来人类制造的最残酷的高科技武器。

EN: Even the old, discarded model can turn your target's guts inside out.
ZH: 即使是废旧的款型也能把你的目标弄得面目全非。

EN: For when you absolutely need to turn someone into lime gelatin.
ZH: 适用于你必须把某人变成青柠果冻的时候。

EN: This little spitfire always gets the job done.
ZH: 喷火虽不大，但总能完成任务。

EN: Something to get excited about, in a strictly molecular sense.
ZH: 让人激动的事，从严格分子层面来说。

EN: Double the fuel, double the heat, double the fun!
ZH: 双倍燃料，双倍热量，双重乐趣！

EN: Wake the dragon and turn your enemies into ash piles.
ZH: 唤醒神龙，把你的敌人变成灰烬。

EN: The mean green melting machine that goes to 11.
ZH: 这台绿色的熔化机器，火力能开到11。

EN: Place that stream of fiery green death right where you want it.
ZH: 将那绿色的死亡之火放在你想要的地方。

EN: Don't get into a bar fight without it.
ZH: 酒吧打架请务必带上它。

EN: Add some hydraulic sauce to an already hearty knuckle sandwich.
ZH: 给本就丰盛的“指节三明治”再加点液压酱汁。

EN: A more sophisticated smashing tool made by your favorite Ghoul.
ZH: 你最喜欢的尸鬼制作的更复杂的拳击工具。

EN: A palpably improved power puncher.
ZH: 明显改进的动力拳套。

EN: Float like a butterfly, sting like a rhinoceros.
ZH: 像蝴蝶一样飘逸，像犀牛一样凶猛。

EN: This pugilist prosthesis has a bit of ring rust.
ZH: 这个拳击手的假肢状态不佳。

EN: Bleeding edge, pre-war offensive electronics.
ZH: 尖端的战前进攻电子设备。

EN: Best results when turned up to 11.
ZH: 威力调到11时效果最佳。

EN: Try to stay upwind of disintegrated targets.
ZH: 尽量站在被蒸发目标的上风口。

EN: This relic can still give your enemies watt-for!
ZH: 这件遗物依然能让你的敌人感受到电流！

EN: Nice rifle. Totally not just slapped together with whatever they could find in New Vegas rubble. Yeah.
ZH: 好枪。绝对不单单是用新维加斯废墟里捡来的东西拼凑出来的。没错。

EN: Give Raiders a taste of their own bad medicine.
ZH: 让掠夺者自己尝尝被这个坏家伙伤害的滋味。

EN: Shoots rail spikes that can pin limbs to walls. Choo choo!
ZH: 用它发射“铁路尖钉”可以将四肢钉在墙上。啾啾！

EN: How fast can rail spikes travel? You don't want to know.
ZH: “铁路尖钉”到底多快？你不会想知道。

EN: You ever see a Raider's head pinned to a wall? Would you like to?
ZH: 你见过墙上钉着掠夺者的脑袋吗？你想看吗？

EN: Modified to pierce and pin even Power Armored limbs.
ZH: 改装过，能穿透穿着动力装甲的四肢。

EN: The ultimate in weaponized rail spike acceleration.
ZH: “铁路尖钉”武器加速的极限。

EN: The odd spike may not pin a limb to a wall, but it'll kill all the same.
ZH: 这个奇怪的尖钉可能不能将四肢钉在墙上，但它还是一样能杀戮。

EN: Cuts through limbs, wood and otherwise, with a satisfying growl.
ZH: 以令人满意的咆哮声切割肢体、木材等材料。

EN: Put on your flannel and go look for some lumber.
ZH: 穿上法兰绒夹克衫，去找些木材吧。

EN: Pretty soon, every raider starts to look like a tree.
ZH: 很快，每个掠夺者在你眼里都会像一棵树。

EN: The chain could use some oil, but it gets the job done.
ZH: 链条需要加油，但它依然能工作。

EN: Feels like it might explode every time you fire it.
ZH: 感觉每次射击时都要爆炸。

EN: Make sure to aim high and about a foot to the left.
ZH: 往上瞄一些，然后再偏左一英尺。

EN: A Wasteland wanderer's most trusted weapon...
ZH: 废土流浪者最信赖的武器……

EN: Half the shotgun, twice the barrels, all the death.
ZH: 枪管减半，枪筒加倍，必死无疑。

EN: Better muzzle velocity and a tighter spread than the standard model.
ZH: 比标准型号枪口速度更快和扩散更紧。

EN: Carrying this, you don't just wander the Wasteland. You own it.
ZH: 带上这个，你不只是在废土上游荡。你将拥有废土。

EN: Can make legs disappear... like magic!
ZH: 可以让腿瞬间消失……像魔术一样！

EN: It's seen a lot of action... but is ready to see some more.
ZH: 见识过了很多行动……但还准备多看一些。

EN: Get close and say hello... with a load of buckshot.
ZH: 贴近了打招呼……用一大把鹿弹。

EN: Two barrels. Double the damage, double the fun!
ZH: 两个筒。双重伤害，双倍乐趣！

EN: Lovingly modified to kill anything within 5 yards.
ZH: 改装过，可以杀死5码以内的任何东西。

EN: You'll marry anyone with this bad boy pointed at your head.
ZH: 不论是谁，只要拿着这个家伙指着你的头，你都会愿意和他结婚。

EN: Get close, get a kill. It's that simple.
ZH: 接近，杀死。如此简单。

EN: It sat in the barn a little too long, but can still kill with the best of 'em.
ZH: 它在谷仓里搁得太久了，但杀起人来依然不输任何好枪。

EN: Take down your target from a neighborhood away.
ZH: 隔着一条街也能放倒你的目标。

EN: Kill the soldier, and the Vertibird he flies in on.
ZH: 干掉士兵，还有他乘坐的那架垂直起降机。

EN: Engineered to shoot a little farther, a little faster.
ZH: 射击得更远，速度更快。

EN: Better scope, better rounds. You'd have to try NOT to kill the target.
ZH: 更好的瞄准镜，更好的弹药。你想不杀死目标都难。

EN: The trigger is a bit loose, but it will still drop a Mirelurk at 300 yards.
ZH: 触发器是松了一点，但它仍然能放倒一个300码外的泥沼蟹。

EN: It's been said that snipers can single-handedly win wars. This is why.
ZH: 据说狙击手单凭一人就能赢得战争。

EN: Has a handy little rocket to increase swing speed and send your enemies into orbit.
ZH: 配备了实用的小型火箭增速装置，以提升挥击速度，将敌人送上云霄。

EN: Like a ripper, but more likely to leave the organs intact. If that's what you're going for.
ZH: 类似齿锯，但更有可能保持器官完整。如果你想要的话。

EN: Clean and well-maintained. A reliable tool for bloody work.
ZH: 干净且维护良好，适合血腥工作的可靠工具。

EN: Synthetic mono-molecular teeth mean they won't even feel their limbs coming off.
ZH: 合成单分子锯齿甚至能让目标感觉不到肢体被切断。

EN: This thing has no place in a proper surgery, but it will do the job.
ZH: 这东西不适合正规手术，但它能完成任务。

EN: Use with appropriate augments to avoid self-maiming.
ZH: 需要使用适当的增强配件，以避免伤到自己。

EN: Sometimes it's better to leave a target breathing. Not sure when, but I assume it's sometimes.
ZH: 有时让目标活着是更好的选择。什么时候比较好，我也不太清楚。

EN: For those who feel that firing one laser just isn't enough.
ZH: 适合那些觉得一发激光还不够的人。

EN: Ultracite ore spinning faster than the speed of screams.
ZH: 辐射极琉矿矿石旋转得比尖叫声还快。

EN: Dozens of refined lumps of ore crammed into an enormous gun. What could go wrong?
ZH: 将数十块精炼矿石塞进一门巨炮，能出什么问题？

EN: Instant Ultracite plasma destruction. Just add power!
ZH: 即刻产生辐射极琉矿等离子破坏效果，注入能量即可！

EN: Fabulously focused photons for fatally fusing fiends.
ZH: 精准聚焦的光子束，用于对付顽固的敌人。

EN: For those times when all you have is a big gem, but what you need is a killing machine.
ZH: 当你手头只有一块大宝石，却需要一件致命武器时。

EN: Scary sharp. Don't put it under your pillow.
ZH: 锋利得令人生畏，别把它放在枕头下面。
